title: Optimize vector batch insert capacity reserve
constraints: Preserve vector dimension validation, upsert semantics, and HNSW build behavior
rationale: Vector batch insert knows the incoming item count before adding vectors to the per-index map. Reserving that capacity up front reduces HashMap growth during batch indexing while keeping existing per-vector validation and index build behavior unchanged.
steps: Reserve the wrapper vector map by incoming batch size
Verify vector index unit behavior and SQL HNSW behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn during vector batch insert without changing search results.
